title: The Machine Without Qt: A Station That Ran Where It Was Built, What Was Not Shipped, and the Path That Only Exists Here
fallback: This lesson is about what has to be in a folder for a program to run on another machine, so it needs Qt. Lesson 04-14 is about a header that changed and took a build with it, and lesson 04-13 about two things that need different versions, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a check of a folder that is to be shipped: the files it must hold, by pattern, and the text files in it that name a path that does not exist
